## Symptom

`scripts/check_uv_pin.py` is the repository's image-pin gate: it rejects an image resolving from a floating `:latest` tag, and asserts the uv image names the exact `[tool.uv] required-version`. It only ever reads Dockerfiles, so every `image:` key in every Compose file lands with no gate objection.

## Evidence from `origin/main`

- `_dockerfiles()` at `scripts/check_uv_pin.py:396-400` builds the entire scanned file set from one glob: `root.glob("**/Dockerfile*")`.
- `check_dockerfiles()` at `:476-494` is the only image scanner; `check_repo()` at `:495-504` composes the 5 checks and has no Compose-aware member.
- The failure epilogue at `:515-524` states the rule as "Every Dockerfile must name ..." and "no Dockerfile may resolve any image from a floating `:latest` tag", so the gap is in the design, not only the glob.
- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` carries 6 `image:` keys the gate never reads, at lines 25, 70, 92, 113, 133 and 149.
- Line 113 is `image: docker.io/minio/minio:latest`, exactly the class the gate exists to reject. It reached `main` unchallenged, then broke `Live External Integration` with `pull access denied for minio/minio` when the upstream repository went away. That instance is bug `6d98-28f4-946a-4016`; this ticket removes the blind spot that allowed it.

## Blast radius

The repository has 3 Compose files. `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` and `tests/external/live_jira_dc/docker-compose.yml` build from Dockerfiles and declare no `image:` key. Only `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` has any. After `6d98` repins line 113, the remaining 5 are `clickhouse-server:24.3`, `redis:7`, and 3 interpolations with a literal default (`${LANGFUSE_IMAGE_TAG:-3.186.0}` twice, `${POSTGRES_VERSION:-17}`), each resolving to an exact tag. The widened gate therefore reports zero findings on a tree carrying `6d98`'s fix, so it lands green. This ticket is linked `discovered_from` `6d98` and follows it.

## Design

1. Add `_compose_files(root)` mirroring `_dockerfiles()`: glob `**/docker-compose*.yml`, `**/docker-compose*.yaml`, `**/compose*.yml`, `**/compose*.yaml`, apply the same `{".git", ".venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__"}` skip set, return sorted and deduplicated.
2. Add `COMPOSE_IMAGE_PATTERN` for `^\s*image:\s*(?P<image>\S+)\s*$`, tolerating a quoted value and a trailing `#` comment. Compose uses `image:` only inside a service block, so a line scan resolves every reference while preserving the line number the `Finding` location needs; `yaml.safe_load` would discard it.
3. Add `check_compose_images(root)` structured exactly like `check_dockerfiles()`, and add it to `check_repo()`.
4. Resolve Compose interpolation before judging. `${VAR:-default}` carries its pin as a literal in the file, so substitute the default and judge the result; that is what lets the gate read 3 of the 6 references on `main` rather than skip them. A defaultless `${VAR}` names no provable tag and is a finding.
5. Delegate the per-reference verdict to the existing `_check_dockerfile_reference()`, renamed `_check_image_reference()`. Its body is already reference-generic — missing tag, `:latest`, non-uv pass-through, `_check_uv_reference` for uv — so one rule serves both file kinds and cannot drift.
6. Update the failure epilogue so it states the rule over both file kinds.

Keep each new function small: the complexity ratchet records a symbol only once it exceeds the `max-complexity = 15` ceiling.

## Mechanism-delta note

This adds no censused mechanism. No lock, env var, config key, feature flag, autouse fixture or test helper, and no new CI gate: `check_uv_pin.py` already runs from `Makefile:439` on every commit and in CI. This widens an existing gate's input set.

## Portability

The scanner is stdlib-only and runs inside `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` from the `lint` target, as the Dockerfile scan does today. It needs no CI provider, no registry network access and no Docker daemon; it reads files. A checkout with no CI gets the same verdict from `make lint`, matching the contract stated at `Makefile:437-438`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` defines `_compose_files()`.
- [x] `_compose_files()` excludes paths under `.git`, `.venv`, `node_modules` or `__pycache__`.
- [x] `_compose_files()` returns exactly `docker-compose.langfuse.yml`, `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`, `tests/external/live_jira_dc/docker-compose.yml` for this repository, with no duplicates.
- [x] `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` defines `check_compose_images()`.
- [x] `check_repo()` includes `check_compose_images()` among the checks it composes.
- [x] A Compose `image:` naming a bare repository, with neither tag nor digest, produces a finding.
- [x] A Compose `image:` whose tag is `latest` produces a finding.
- [x] A Compose `image:` with an exact tag produces no finding.
- [x] A non-uv Compose `image:` pinned by bare digest produces no finding.
- [x] A Compose `image:` of the form `${VAR:-1.2.3}` produces no finding.
- [x] A Compose `image:` of the form `${VAR:-latest}` produces a finding.
- [x] A defaultless Compose `image:` of the form `${VAR}` produces a finding.
- [x] A Compose `image:` naming the uv image with a tag other than `[tool.uv] required-version` produces a finding.
- [x] A Compose `image:` naming the uv image by digest alone produces a finding.
- [x] Each Compose finding's location names the Compose file path.
- [x] Each Compose finding's location names the 1-based line number of the offending `image:` line.
- [x] `_check_dockerfile_reference` is renamed `_check_image_reference`.
- [x] Every call site of the renamed function is updated.
- [x] `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` contains exactly one implementation of the floating-tag rule.
- [x] The failure epilogue text states that the pin rule covers Compose `image:` keys.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` asserts the reported line number for at least one Compose finding.
- [x] `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` reports no finding against this repository's own tree.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py` exits 0.
- [x] CI's gating `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` cell passes on the merged revision, evidenced by `Verified +1` on Gerrit change 3004 at `c0b1ad2e8e9`. [non-codebase] The local `make verify` equivalent is not runnable on this macOS host: `pypandoc-binary==1.17`'s arm64 wheel ships an x86_64 pandoc, failing 17 unrelated tests.

## Testing

Each Compose case builds a temporary root holding a `pyproject.toml` with a known `[tool.uv] required-version` plus one Compose file, matching the fixture style the existing Dockerfile cases use. During development run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_uv_pin_guard.py -q`. Then run `python scripts/check_uv_pin.py` against the real checkout to confirm the widened gate is clean on `main`, and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` before pushing.

## Source

Discovered while fixing `6d98-28f4-946a-4016`, where a floating `docker.io/minio/minio:latest` in `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` broke `Live External Integration` on `main`.
